title: source/status/v1
description: An adapter's status, every 2 s (spec 04 §3.6), in the common envelope. Produced by every system (decision record M14). A disabled source says who disabled it and how; it is never merely silent (02 F9, LESSONS B-11). The body is also the item of `console/status/v1` `sources[]`.

source_instance.description: The instance (client id, receiver id, provider id); null for the status of the adapter type as a whole.

state.description: `unknown` is the state a follower holds before it has read any control state; it is treated as enabled and logged (04 §3.6, LESSONS B-09).

age_s.description: Seconds since the newest record from this source, on this system's clock; null when it has never been heard.

disabled_by.description: How the source is disabled: by type, by instance or by a default-deny state (knowledge/vectors/source_control.json `why_disabled`). Non-null exactly when `state` is `disabled`.

disabled_by_who.description: The person who disabled it, as the audit log names them (02 F9 "disabled by <who>").

counters.description: Monotonic counters since the adapter started: at least accepted and refused (04 §3.6); further non-negative integer counters (`dropped_*`, `gap`, ...) may be added.
